name: drip-type
description: Private, configurable typing for macOS — Drip Type by Zap.
author: VegaNext LLC

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/quick.js && node --check src/shortcut-utils.js && node --check src/text-tools.js && node --check src/pro-tools.js && node --check src/subscription.js && node --check src/onboarding.js && node --check scripts/build-app.js && node --check scripts/after-pack.js && node --check scripts/publish-update-blobs.js && node --check scripts/test-shortcuts.js && node --check scripts/verify-api.js && node --check scripts/verify-source.js && node --check scripts/verify-package.js
scripts.test:source: node scripts/test-shortcuts.js && node scripts/verify-source.js && node scripts/verify-api.js
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:source && npm run build:app
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:app && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never

releaseInfo.releaseNotes: Shortcuts now capture the exact key combination you press, validate availability before saving, and safely keep the previous working shortcuts if registration fails. The default Composer shortcut is Option+5. Typing controls now flush before a session begins, and custom shortcuts stay consistent across Settings, Setup, the sidebar, and the menu bar.

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Drip Type uses macOS System Events to type text into the application you choose.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Drip Type needs Accessibility access to type text into other applications.
